description: Corrections to the Swahili source texts, kept here so a rebuild applies them again. <TRANSLATION>.<book>.<chapter> replaces a whole chapter; strip.<TRANSLATION>["book:chapter:verse"] removes stray text; replace.<TRANSLATION>["book:chapter:verse"] is a list of [as printed, corrected]; bookNames.<TRANSLATION>[book] is the name shown in place of the source's running head. None are needed yet.
